notes: Blue school board with Lao flag and Ministry of Education badge, Luang Prabang. The painted French uses a lower-case l in 'ÉCOlE' (transcribed as painted). ຫລວງ is written with separate ຫ+ລ (not ຫຼ). location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

lines.latin: Ban Don Khun, M[ueang] Ngoy (Don Khoun village, Ngoy district)

notes: Hand-painted blue village entrance board near Nong Khiaw, shot from below; painted dots separate abbreviations (B. = Ban, MG. = Mueang). Small red text under the Lao line is unreadable. The lower board (project notice: pond 150 m x 150 m, by the TABI project) is a distractor and not labelled. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

lines.latin: Ho Phiphithaphan Haeng Xat Louang Phabang (Luang Prabang National Museum)

notes: Small red-and-gold name board on two red posts in front of the white wall of the former Royal Palace, Luang Prabang; temple (Haw Pha Bang) behind. Board is small in the 1024 px frame. 'LUANGPRABANG' is written as one word.

lines.text: ຖະໜົນ ຟລັ່ງຊົວງິນ

notes: Green bilingual street-name sign with gold frame on an ornamental pole, Vientiane; the sign is fairly small in the frame. ໜ is encoded as the single letter U+0EDC. Distractors: 'Sabaidee Coffee' (ສະບາຍດີກາເຟ) hanging sign and fascia, a no-entry sign, a partly hidden 'LAO ...' board.

lines.latin: Simon hatthakam po sa (Simone mulberry-paper handicraft)

notes: Carved gold-on-black shop board under a small shingle roof, Luang Prabang; medium distance with foliage in front of the lower post. The TEL line is small and slightly soft. A parked tuk-tuk at right is incidental.

author: jillllybean
attribution: Photo: jillllybean, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Laos_2015_(21856299069).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hanging lightbox, rue François, Ban Mixai, Vientiane; cables cross behind it. The Lao top line continues with the restaurant name (ອາເ?່ຍ) after ຮ້ານອາຫານ; its consonant is drawn in a Thai-style font where ຮ and ຣ look alike, so the name word is not transcribed. Address/phone lines not labelled: '8 rue francois, ban mixai, vientiane lao pdr', 'phone (856) 21 222 589 - 030 570 0831', 'ariamixairestaurant@gmail.com - www.ariaorg.com'. 'acqua' letters on the building at left are a distractor.

author: Christophe95
attribution: Photo: Christophe95, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Don_Khone_school.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted gate board of the primary school on Don Khon island. Only the French line is labelled: the large Lao line above (school name, ending in ...ບ້ານຄອນ / Ban Khon) and the small Lao address line (village, district, Champasak province) are stylised handwriting that cannot be transcribed reliably. Round emblem at left, school badge at right.

notes: Carved hanging board, Luang Prabang, seen from below. The Lao line continues with the name (two words, 'ມ…ວ ພ…ກ'), but the stacked vowel/tone marks on them cannot be read with confidence, so only the first word ເຮືອນພັກ is transcribed.

lines.text: ວັດສົບສິກຂາຣ

notes: Red-and-gold temple name board in Luang Prabang, partly behind tree branches. A branch hides the end of the Lao line: after ຣ only the top prongs of the final consonant (presumably ...າມ, 'aram') are visible, so the Lao line is transcribed only up to ຣ. The Latin line is written as one word.

notes: Hand-painted yellow welcome board with the Lao flag on Don Sao island (Golden Triangle), shot from below at an angle. lines.text: ເມືອງຈັນທະບູລີ

notes: Small blue village board on a pylon across the street, Vientiane (low-resolution, 1280 px source). The third line (Lao village name 'ບ.ສີຫອມ ...' plus 'model sanitary village' wording) is too blurred for its vowel and tone marks to be transcribed reliably, so it is left out. Distractors: pedestrian-crossing and '30' speed signs, 'ETL' sign, Lao 'ຂາຍ...' arrow sign on the pylon, furniture shop, pickup with plate (small, incidental).

lines.latin: Han Mi A Tu (A Du noodle shop)
A Du Mianguan (A Du noodle restaurant)

notes: Large trilingual fascia in Vientiane, shot from below; overhead cables cross the sign. 'A DU' is in decorative script capitals. ໝ is the single letter U+0EDD. The banner below (opening notice with dish photos, Lao/Chinese captions, 'Tel: 020-6..5008' partly hidden) and phone-shop signs (M-PHONE, tigo) are distractors. One man in the doorway is incidental.

author: Prince Roy

notes: Rainbow fascia of a Chinese restaurant in Vientiane. The large Lao line (restaurant + name 'ອາຫານ...ຈິວ') is cut at the top frame edge, so its first word and tone marks are incomplete and it is not transcribed. Phone line 'Tel:021-213059 020-6235691' (last digits partly cut) not labelled. Window lettering in Chinese (欢迎光临, 宴席接待, 散餐服务, dish names) and a Beerlao stand are distractors. Parked motorbikes incidental.
